Help Center • FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about AsbiMart products, ordering, delivery, payments & returns

1. Are all AsbiMart products 100% pure and chemical-free? +
Yes! Every single product—including Sundarbans wild honey, Pabna Danadar cow ghee, cold-pressed mustard oil, nuts, and spices—is sourced directly from trusted local producers and lab-tested for purity with zero artificial colors, added sugar, or preservatives.
2. How do I place an order on AsbiMart? +
Click on any product, select your preferred weight/size, click Order Now or Add to Cart, and enter your name, 11-digit phone number, and delivery address. You can place an order in under 30 seconds—even without creating an account.
3. How long does delivery take and what are the delivery charges? +
Inside Dhaka City: 24–48 hours home delivery (৳60 charge). Outside Dhaka (nationwide across all districts and upazilas): 2–3 working days home delivery (৳120 charge).
4. What payment methods are accepted? Do I need to pay in advance? +
No advance payment is required! We offer full Cash on Delivery (COD) nationwide so you can inspect your parcel before paying. We also accept bKash, Nagad, Rocket, and Bank Transfer for instant online checkout.
5. How can I track my order after placing it? +
After confirming your order, you receive a unique Order ID (e.g. ASBI-782910). Visit our Track Order page and enter your Order ID or phone number to see live shipment & courier updates.
6. What is your Return & Refund policy? +
We guarantee a hassle-free 7-day return & 100% refund policy. You may check the parcel in front of the delivery rider. If any item is damaged, incorrect, or fails your quality expectations, return it at zero delivery cost and receive a full refund within 3 working days.
7. Why does pure honey sometimes crystallize in winter? +
Crystallization is a completely natural sign of raw, unprocessed honey (especially Mustard and Litchi flower honey) due to natural glucose content in cool weather. Simply place the sealed glass jar in warm (not boiling) water for a few minutes and it will return to liquid form.
8. How should I store Danadar Cow Ghee and Cold-Pressed Mustard Oil? +
Always use a clean, dry spoon for ghee and keep the jar tightly sealed in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight (no refrigerator needed). Keep mustard oil tightly capped away from heat to preserve its natural aroma and pungency for 6–12 months.
9. Can I change my delivery address or cancel an order? +
Yes! Before your parcel is handed over to our courier partner (usually within 3–4 hours of ordering), call our hotline at 01821-296056 or message us on WhatsApp to modify your address, items, or cancel free of charge.
10. Do you accept wholesale or corporate gift orders? +
Absolutely! We supply customized organic gift boxes for weddings, Eid, corporate events, and wholesale retail partners at special bulk pricing. Reach out via our Contact Us page for a custom quote.
11. What happens if a glass jar breaks during courier delivery? +
We pack every jar with food-grade tamper-proof seals, double bubble-wrap, and reinforced cartons. In the rare case of transit damage, simply send us a photo and we will send a brand-new replacement completely free of charge.
12. What are your customer support hours? +
Our support team is available every day from 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM via Hotline (01821-296056), WhatsApp (+880 1821-296056), Email (asby056@gmail.com), and our official Facebook page.
